# `try_avg`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the mean calculated from values of a group and the result is null on overflow.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
try_avg(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.3.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- try_avg, example 1
> SELECT try_avg(col) FROM VALUES (1), (2), (3) AS tab(col);
2.0
```

```sql
-- try_avg, example 2
> SELECT try_avg(col) FROM VALUES (1), (2), (NULL) AS tab(col);
1.5
```

```sql
-- try_avg, example 3
> SELECT try_avg(col) FROM VALUES (interval '2147483647 months'), (interval '1 months') AS tab(col);
NULL
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.3.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
